title: Workflow rules: can't assign a ticket to a team and an agent of that team in one rule
label: MISSING · High

panels.caption: TAVI · rule actions · one Owner Assignment (Users / Teams / …); Teams drops the owner; Owner Assignment is not offered again
NDC Zoho · Accounting › ADM Assignment Airline OPS · action "Assign Ticket" (set to Team with Agent)

rows: Assign to a team and an agent
"Assign Ticket" with Assignee = Team with Agent: the ticket goes to the team and to a named agent of that team in one step. 19 NDC rules use it.

Owner Assignment takes users or teams, not both. With Teams: "The ticket goes to the team and loses its owner." Tested 3 Nov: Field Update Team + Owner Assignment to a user in one rule left the ticket with the team set and no owner.
The same rule also shares the ticket (Share Ticket).
Owner Assignment can't be added twice ("A rule can have only one OwnerAssignment action"); the Add action list does not offer it again.
